claimLimit: Conditional static table references. Visibility and runtime use are unobserved.

hostSource.sha256Input: Whole files with CRLF normalized to LF.

denominator.scope: All 156 columns of each WALLDEF slice selected by any nonzero GEO1#34 wall nibble.

eclControl.loadCondition: Byte [0x4bf2] differs from 34. Equality executes EXIT at 0x801b.
eclControl.twoSetReason: The two SAVE sites set bytes [0x4be7] and [0x4be8] to 1 before LOAD_PIECES.

indexConvention: GEO wall slots and symbol sets are one-based. Map coordinates, TOC entries, record indices, slice indices, columns, byte offsets and tile indices are zero-based.
